scope: Read-only re-review of the isolated CLIP source-verification scheduling candidate and the two original review fixes. Real benchmark and production integration remain separate.

original_findings_disposition.original_title: Complete frozen H code bundle is not rebound after verification
evidence: parallel_source.py:45-58 FrozenHashes freshly hashes every selected file at construction, before operation and after operation.
benchmark_source.py:9-17 with_frozen_sources selects every reliability_v2/*.py file, guards the actual expensive operation, and rejects source inventory changes.
benchmark_source.py:79 binds accepted terminal/config/registry/candidate inputs and candidate tests together with all package Python files around collection and original ledger comparison.
benchmark_source.py:80 rechecks the complete worker_h.h_code_hash bundle against pinned configuration before publication.
tests/test_parallel_source.py:136-153 adds four late-drift cases for worker_h.py/data_h.py/qualification_h.py/queue_d.py with queue_h unchanged and a stable-operation positive case.

original_findings_disposition.original_title: Direct report write can leave an incomplete artifact on write failure
evidence: parallel_source.py:60-73 serializes the complete result before I/O, writes and fsyncs a unique same-directory .partial, then hardlinks it atomically to a new final name with no overwrite. Successful publication removes its temporary.

tests/test_parallel_source.py:155-179 covers complete publication, existing-result preservation, serialization failure without output, and fsync failure leaving only separately named partial evidence.

preserved_behaviors: Original full worker_h.verify_run_completion still runs freshly for all ten models with at most two verifier threads.
FreshLookup remains one-use and configuration-bound; the ORIGINAL queue_h.audit_paired_ledgers consumes the fresh receipts.
Every supported original JSON ledger field/type is compared except top-level utc.
The held source-only phase check, metadata stability checks, CPU-only environment, no-overwrite reporting and inert default entry remain present.
No production source, training/configuration/model, target authorization, gate, effective registry, GPU service or Git state was modified by this review.
